text: 昨天还和娃爸感叹，我活到了四十五岁，还从没有和30岁以上的男人交往过。
en: Just yesterday I was remarking to the child's father, with a sigh, that I've made it to forty-five and have never once dated a man over thirty.

text: 从小到大内心来说一直都是喜欢比自己大的男性，除了初恋比自己大一岁，以后再认识到的男人都比自己小，且越来越小。
en: Deep down, from childhood to now, I've always liked men older than myself. Apart from my first love, who was one year older, every man I got to know after that was younger than me — and getting younger and younger.

text: 工作原因平时社交不多，亲戚朋友也没有帮我介绍过对象，只能靠运气碰。
en: Because of work I don't socialise much, and neither relatives nor friends have ever set me up, so I can only rely on luck to bump into someone.

text: 结果吸引到的全是奶狗。
en: The result was that all I attracted were puppy dogs.

text: 最小的就是娃爸了，小多少岁不说了，都是普通人，他安慰我说，你不要急，过几年我就三十了，你也算心愿达成了。
en: The youngest is the child's father. I won't say how many years younger he is — we're both ordinary people. He comforted me, saying, 'Don't fret, in a few years I'll be thirty, and you can count your wish as fulfilled.'

text: 听起来是不是像在说故事。
en: Doesn't this sound like someone telling a story?

text: 都四十岁了，其实男女差别已经没那么大了。
en: We're both forty now, and honestly the gap between men and women isn't that big anymore.

text: 普通打工人，40岁男的精子质量就和女性生育能力一样，都下降到基本临界值了；工作上基本也都是随时裁员等回家的状态；至于外貌，也都属于强行维持了，皱纹肚子全都有了。
en: For ordinary workers, a forty-year-old man's sperm quality, like a woman's fertility, has dropped to roughly the critical level; at work, both are essentially in a state of being laid off at any moment, just waiting to go home; as for looks, it's all just being forcibly maintained — wrinkles and paunches, they've got them all.

text: 个别身体素质奇差的，可能还会早更早衰之类的。
en: A few with unusually poor physical constitutions might even go through early menopause or premature ageing, and so on.

text: 这个时候的男女该吃过的亏都吃过了，再笨也学会用脑子而不是下半身思考了。
en: By this age, both men and women have suffered all the setbacks there are to suffer; however dim-witted, they've learned to think with their brains rather than their lower halves.

text: 所以说40岁男的不考虑40岁女的原因其实和40岁女的不考虑40岁男的原因一样：女的不愿意找个随时失业的秃头大肚子老头，男的同理。
en: So the reason a forty-year-old man won't consider a forty-year-old woman is actually the same as why a forty-year-old woman won't consider a forty-year-old man: a woman doesn't want to end up with a bald, paunchy old man who could be unemployed at any moment, and it's the same the other way round.

text: 因为你是相亲平台啊，当然是来许愿的，花了钱还不让许愿吗？
en: Because you're a matchmaking platform, of course people come to make a wish — they've paid money, so are they not allowed to make a wish?

text: 现实中我认识的普遍不会找小太多的，即使有心，也没那个经济能力啊，唯一认识个40岁男找30岁女的，女的是去当全职太太来着，注意是全职太太，不是家庭主妇，男的对女的经济是完全碾压的，说得更确切一点女的农村的有点小姿色，男的小老板，这种情况男的才能忽略颜值，否则我看到的是普遍帅哥配美女，年轻女孩宁可找同龄男孩，人家一起通宵蹦迪，40岁男人行吗？
en: In real life, the people I know generally won't go for someone much younger; even if they wanted to, they don't have the financial means. The only case I know of a forty-year-old man with a thirty-year-old woman — the woman went to be a full-time wife, note, a full-time wife, not a housewife. The man completely out-earns the woman; to be precise, the woman is from the countryside with a bit of looks, the man a small-time boss — only in this sort of situation can the man overlook appearance. Otherwise, what I see is generally handsome men paired with beautiful women; young girls would rather find boys their own age, who can stay up all night clubbing together — can a forty-year-old man manage that?

text: 你说的40岁男是指那些事业有成有房有车有社会地位的单身男士么？
en: By 'forty-year-old men' do you mean those single gentlemen who are successful in their careers, with a house, a car, and social standing?

text: 要不你采访下农村寡居务农打零工的老光棍？
en: Why don't you go interview the old bachelors in the countryside who are widowed, farm the land, and do odd jobs?

text: 哦也对，在你眼里，他们不算40岁男，算老牲口。
en: Oh, right — in your eyes they don't count as forty-year-old men, they count as old livestock.

text: 你身为相亲机构工作人员，先想想正常男人结婚最根本的动力是什么？
en: You, as a member of staff at a matchmaking agency, first ask yourself what the most fundamental drive is for an ordinary man to get married?

text: 许多男人会费尽心思去追求20出头的年轻小姑娘，但他们不会去追求40多岁的女人，他们对40多岁的女人往往是敬而远之的，为什么他们不会去碰40多岁的女人呢？
en: Many men will rack their brains to pursue young girls just out of their teens, but they won't pursue women in their forties; they tend to keep women in their forties at a respectful distance. Why is it that they won't go near women in their forties?

text: 20多岁的小姑娘好哄好骗好追求，不像40多岁的女人，脾气又硬，要求又多，大多数男人都不喜欢太挑剔太难追的女人，20多岁的小姑娘比较好追，40多岁的女人真的很难追，这就是为什么大多数男人不会去碰40多岁女人的原因。
en: Girls in their twenties are easy to coax, easy to fool, and easy to court, unlike women in their forties, who have stubborn tempers and many demands. Most men don't like women who are too picky and too hard to win over; girls in their twenties are easier to court, women in their forties are truly hard to win over — that is why most men won't go near women in their forties.

text: 追求20多岁的小姑娘，你给她买个一两千的东西，她会非常开心，追求40多岁的女人，你给她买个一两千的东西，她只会觉得很平常，甚至都不会跟你说谢谢，会觉得你这些付出根本就不值得一提。
en: When pursuing a girl in her twenties, if you buy her something worth one or two thousand, she'll be overjoyed; when pursuing a woman in her forties, if you buy her something worth one or two thousand, she'll just find it perfectly ordinary, might not even say thank you, and will think your efforts aren't worth mentioning at all.

text: 对比这么明显，男人肯定选择不去碰40多岁的女人，以免吃力不讨好。
en: With such an obvious contrast, men will naturally choose not to go near women in their forties, to avoid thankless effort.

text: 为什么不去碰40多岁的女人？
en: Why not go near women in their forties?

text: 因为不想给自己惹麻烦，这个岁数的女人，很多时候对感情的要求很高，这个岁数单身的女人要么就是从来都没有结过婚，要么就是已经离了婚，这种女人如果我没有决心要跟她过一辈子，绝对不要去碰她。
en: Because they don't want to bring trouble on themselves. Women of this age often have very high expectations in relationships; single women of this age are either those who have never married, or those already divorced. A woman like that — if I don't have the resolve to spend my whole life with her, I absolutely must not go near her.

text: 最好是远离这种女人，我觉得20出头的女人或者接近30岁的女人最好追求，因为这些女人都比较恨嫁，对爱情还有向往，40多岁的女人都精明得很，她们怎么会相信男人，她们只想从男人身上得到她们想要的东西，男人如果去追求40多岁的女人，只会被她们耍得团团转，我不喜欢40多岁的女人。
en: Best to keep away from this kind of woman. I think women just out of their teens or approaching thirty are the easiest to court, because such women are quite eager to marry and still yearn for love. Women in their forties are terribly shrewd — how could they ever trust men? They only want to take from men what they want. If a man pursues a woman in her forties, he'll just be spun around in circles by her. I don't like women in their forties.

text: 如果你去辜负一个20多岁的女人，这个年轻女人不会报复你，但如果你去辜负一个40多岁的女人，你试试看，结果绝对是可怕的，40多岁的女人不是容易相处的女人，
en: If you let down a woman in her twenties, this young woman won't take revenge on you; but if you let down a woman in her forties, just you try — the outcome will absolutely be dreadful. A woman in her forties is not an easy woman to get along with,

text: 也不是可以轻易辜负的女人，男人如果只抱着玩一玩的心态，不想对她负责，绝对会被她报复的，这就是为什么我不愿意去碰40多岁女人的原因，
en: nor a woman you can casually let down. If a man only holds a 'just for fun' attitude and has no intention of taking responsibility for her, he will absolutely be avenged by her — and that is why I'm reluctant to go near women in their forties,

text: 这个年纪的女人在感情上有一定的阅历，在生活上也很精明，也已经非常的现实，不像20多岁的女人那样单纯天真，这个年纪的女人，
en: Women of this age have a certain amount of experience in matters of the heart, are very shrewd in daily life, and have become thoroughly pragmatic; unlike women in their twenties, who are innocent and naive. Women of this age,

text: 大多数男人都不会去惹她。
en: most men won't provoke.

text: 这几年，网上对所谓大龄剩女的戾气很重。
en: In recent years, there has been a strong undercurrent of hostility online towards so-called 'leftover women' of advanced age.

text: 比如知乎上但凡是涉及大龄女性的回答下面，都有是各种嘲讽，比如“年龄是大龄剩女最小的问题”。
en: For instance, under any Zhihu answer touching on older women, there is all manner of mockery, such as 'age is the least of a leftover woman's problems'.

text: 兄弟们对年纪大的女生嗤之以鼻，男人不管多大年纪都喜欢十八的，以及各种炫耀自己找了个年纪小的老婆，这里要承认一点，我不对大龄女性嗤之以鼻，但是男生确实普遍喜欢年龄小点，我女朋友比就比我小八岁，但是个人喜好，不代表广泛现实，所以如果不明就里的人看了，真的会觉得，广大男同胞们，真的都会去找个比自己小很多的。
en: Lads sneer at older girls; men, no matter their age, like eighteen-year-olds, and they show off having found themselves a younger wife. I'll concede one point here: I don't sneer at older women, but boys genuinely do, on the whole, prefer younger ones — my girlfriend is, simply, eight years younger than me. But personal taste doesn't stand for broad reality; so if someone who doesn't understand the situation were to read this, they'd really come away thinking that we menfolk all go and find someone far younger than ourselves.

text: 实事求是，喜欢是一回事，真正去谈又是另外一回事，不是说女生年龄就如何如何，大部分人谈恋爱，最终走向婚姻殿堂，更看重合适不合适，我算是阅女无数了，要是纯粹颜控，纯粹找年龄小点，我都离婚多少次了，何以至于这把年纪，经历多少过往，才遇见一个合适的对象
en: To be realistic, liking someone is one thing, actually dating them is another; it's not that a girl's age is this or that. Most people, when they fall in love and finally walk towards the marriage altar, care more about whether it's a good fit. I've seen countless women; if I were purely looks-driven and purely after younger ones, I'd have been divorced heaven knows how many times — how else would I have reached this age, after all that has happened, to finally meet a suitable partner?

text: 我认识我女朋友前，还认识一个98年的小码农妹子呢，漂亮是真漂亮，人家姑娘也喜欢我，主要是真的不合适结婚，我又不是那种谈个恋爱，玩一玩的年龄和心境了，真的不能耽误人家的青春
en: Before I met my girlfriend, I also knew a little coder girl born in '98 — genuinely pretty, and the girl liked me too; mainly, we really weren't suited for marriage, and I'm no longer at the age or in the frame of mind to date just for fun. I really couldn't waste her youth.

text: 大部分人需要考虑的问题很多，家世背景，个人情况，几方面综合考虑权衡利弊后，才会走到一起，大家看中的，基本都还是合适自己的，男女都一样。
en: Most people have a great many things to weigh — family background, personal circumstances — and only come together after considering several aspects and balancing the pros and cons. What people value is, basically, what suits themselves, and that holds for both men and women.

text: 如果真的有个年轻漂亮的，但是其他不够合适的姑娘，让你奔着结婚去，其实大部分男人不会选。
en: If there really were a young, pretty girl who fell short in other ways, and you were to pursue marriage with her, most men actually wouldn't choose her.

text: 不是不想，而是不能。
en: It's not that they don't want to, but that they can't.

text: 因为凡事，都得先想想合适不合适。
en: Because in all things, you must first ask whether it's a good fit.

text: 人家二十八你三十七，那人家总得图你点儿啥。
en: She's twenty-eight and you're thirty-seven — then she must want something out of you.

text: 那么问题来了。
en: Then the question arises.

text: 你有啥？
en: What have you got?

text: 人家能图你啥？
en: What could she possibly want from you?

text: 你是天龙人开局富二代，还是白手起家杰出青年创一代？
en: Are you a 'celestial dragon' born into a rich second-generation family, or a self-made outstanding young first-generation entrepreneur?

text: 你是长得像胡歌彭于晏，还是有一颗金刚不坏的肾？
en: Do you look like Ge Hu or Yu-yan Peng, or do you possess an indestructible kidney?

text: 这种潘驴邓小闲，能占两样就是牛人了，能占三样就是人中龙凤，但是大部分人根本遇不到，大部分人还是个普通人，哪怕有些条件稍微好点儿的，也还在这个范畴里。
en: As for this 'Pan An's looks, a donkey's virility, Deng Tong's wealth, youth, and leisure' — to possess two of them makes you a remarkable person; to possess three makes you a dragon among men. But most people never come close to any of it; most remain ordinary folk, and even those with somewhat better conditions still fall within this scope.

text: 普通人，最后找的也大概率都是普通人。
en: Ordinary people, in the end, will most likely end up with other ordinary people.

text: 非要举个极端点儿例子的话，你看看武大郎。
en: If you insist on an extreme example, look at Da-lang Wu.

text: 娶个年轻漂亮的老婆，这里边的底层逻辑不是老婆，而是年轻漂亮。
en: To take a young, beautiful wife — the underlying logic here isn't the wife, but young and beautiful.

text: 年轻漂亮，本身就是一种奢侈品。
en: Youth and beauty are, in themselves, a kind of luxury.

text: 这个道理，对于男女都通用。
en: This principle holds for both men and women.

text: 比如不知妻美那位，人家有这个底气和实力，娶一个既年轻漂亮又学历家境俱佳的老婆。
en: Take, for example, that gentleman who claims not to know his wife is beautiful — he has the confidence and the means to marry a wife who is both young and beautiful, with excellent education and family background.

text: 再比如那些女明星每年在美容护肤上花的钱，可能都够买套学区房了。
en: Or take those actress celebrities, who may spend enough each year on beauty and skincare to buy a school-district flat.

text: 对于普通人来说，对婚姻的想象，更多的是人间烟火柴米油盐，而不是夜夜笙歌。
en: For ordinary people, the image of marriage is far more about the everyday — firewood, rice, oil and salt — than about nightly merrymaking.

text: 那为什么大部分人天天说要找个年轻的呢？
en: Then why is it that most people say every day they want to find a younger one?

text: 这就好比去商场买东西。
en: It's like going to a shop in the mall to buy something.

text: 比如说你看中一件衣服，老板说100块。
en: Say you fancy a garment, and the shopkeeper says 100 yuan.

text: 你左看看又看看，说隔壁家同样的衣服只卖80，质量还更好，做出一副拔腿准备去隔壁店买的架势。
en: You look it over this way and that, and say the shop next door sells the very same garment for only 80, with even better quality, striking a pose as if you're about to pick up and go to the next shop.

text: 结果那个腿啊，就是拔不出去。
en: But that leg of yours just won't lift to leave.

text: 其实隔壁店的价格，跟这家一样，你去跟隔壁老板说80，人家一样不卖你。
en: In truth, the next shop's price is the same as this one's. If you go and offer the next shopkeeper 80, they won't sell to you either.

text: 你这么说，是为了唬老板，压价格。
en: You say that to bluff the shopkeeper and beat the price down.

text: 一样的道理。
en: Same logic.

text: 最后找个年轻貌美老婆的，有，但不多。
en: In the end, those who land a young and beautiful wife — there are some, but not many.

text: 大部分人，还是在同等条件下的婚恋市场上挣扎。
en: Most people are still struggling in the marriage market on equal footing.

text: 偶尔看到一两个条件超越自身的，抱着幻想上去询问，也会被以各种不合适的的理由婉拒。
en: Occasionally, spotting one or two whose conditions surpass their own, they approach with starry-eyed fantasies, only to be gently turned away with various reasons of incompatibility.

text: 有过几次，也就死心了。
en: After a few such times, they let go of hope.

text: 因为结婚，本来就不是为了年轻漂亮去的。
en: Because marriage was never, at root, about pursuing youth and beauty.

text: 为啥要结婚呢？
en: So why get married?

text: 组建家庭，生儿育女，融入社会，抵御风险，相互扶持，需要陪伴…
en: To build a family, bear and raise children, fit into society, guard against risk, support one another, and have someone to keep you company…

text: 这么多理由里，就没有一个跟年轻漂亮沾边。
en: Among so many reasons, not one has anything to do with youth and beauty.

text: 而当满足了这些基础的，才会对外貌有所要求。
en: Only once these basic needs are met does one then have demands about appearance.

text: 也就是饱暖思那啥。
en: Which is to say, once fed and warm, one begins to think of... that.

text: 只是普通人，能满足这些就已经不容易了，又哪有什么资格，去额外要求呢？
en: It's just that for ordinary people, merely meeting these is already no easy feat — so what qualification do they have to ask for anything more?

text: 大龄相亲，年龄是优势也是劣势。
en: Matchmaking at an advanced age: age is both an advantage and a disadvantage.

text: 优势在于，你的年龄证明了，你不是来玩玩的，大概率是正经想要结婚的。
en: The advantage is that your age proves you're not here to play games; you very likely genuinely want to marry.

text: 劣势在于，你的可能性变少了，留给你的适龄单身变少了。
en: The disadvantage is that your options have shrunk, and the age-appropriate singles left to you have dwindled.

text: 25岁相亲，上下探5岁，20-30岁，都是觉得还挺正常的。
en: Matchmaking at twenty-five, reaching five years up or down — twenty to thirty — all feels perfectly normal.

text: 但35岁相亲，上下探5岁，那就是30-40岁，这才是你的年龄区间，反而20-30岁的婚恋主力军，却离你越来越远。
en: But matchmaking at thirty-five, reaching five years up or down, lands at thirty to forty — that is your age bracket; meanwhile the twenty-to-thirty main force of the marriage market drifts ever further from you.

text: 其实不管是同龄，还是年纪比自己小很多，其实都不重要。
en: Actually, whether it's someone the same age or someone far younger, it doesn't really matter.

text: 重要的是，你得清楚这几点：
en: What matters is that you're clear on these few points:

text: 自己是个什么样子。
en: What sort of person you are.

text: 结婚是为了什么。
en: What you're marrying for.

text: 我最终，能和什么样的人结婚。
en: Who, in the end, I can actually marry.

text: 年轻漂亮谁都喜欢，男女都一样。
en: Everyone likes youth and beauty; men and women alike.

text: 可你一方面又想找个贤惠懂事的，一方面又想找个年轻漂亮的…
en: Yet on the one hand you want a virtuous, sensible one, and on the other a young, beautiful one…

text: 至于既年轻漂亮又贤惠懂事的，有。
en: As for those who are both young and beautiful and virtuous and sensible — they do exist.

text: 但你得先问问自己能等价值交换吗？
en: But you must first ask yourself whether you can offer equal value in exchange?

text: 我老跟我女朋友开玩笑，我是经历多少，付出了多少代价，才练就了今天的自己，遇见她，相遇相识，彼此还对眼，真的不容易，算是老天给自己的奖励吧，所以我常常给自己说好好珍惜吧
en: I often joke with my girlfriend that it took so much experience and so great a price to forge the person I am today; meeting her, coming to know each other, and finding one another pleasing to the eye — it truly wasn't easy. It counts as a reward heaven gave me, so I often tell myself to treasure it well.
